headline: Come for the Cottage in ‘Heated Rivalry.’ Stay for Everything Else.
context: The chance to see the hideaway from the hit queer hockey romance lured me to Canada’s cottage country. But it was the glistening lakes and weep-worthy sunsets that won me over.
